ownership: plans.owner_user_id -> auth_users.id; all child access derives from that owner; acting user comes only from validated server session
migration_audit: diary_imports.user_id UNIQUE; original source IDs mapped per account; dates/values/minutes preserved

study_tables.study_experiments: id PK, user_id UNIQUE FK auth_users ON DELETE CASCADE, start_date Seoul date, protocol immutable JSON, created_at UTC ISO
study_tables.study_days: id PK, experiment_id FK ON DELETE CASCADE, day_number, date, task_id FK tasks, expected_minutes snapshot, actual_minutes nullable, evidence JSON, note, opened_at UTC ISO, closed_at nullable UTC ISO; UNIQUE(experiment_id, day_number), UNIQUE(experiment_id, date)
study_tables.study_rule_changes: id PK, experiment_id UNIQUE FK ON DELETE CASCADE, rule, reason, day_one_id and day_two_id FK study_days, changed_at UTC ISO

time_rules: auth timestamps are epoch milliseconds; diary/study timestamps are UTC ISO; study dates use Asia/Seoul; Monday starts week
study_metric: absolute(actual_minutes - expected_minutes) in minutes per closed day; missing days excluded, explicit no-study is zero; sum unrounded values, mean over closed days; display rounded to one decimal
account_deletion: Authenticated POST /api/account/delete requires same origin, current password (Better Auth scrypt verifier), literal confirmation, per-account rate limit; atomic D1 batch deletes own diary children, study rule changes/days/experiment (including archived attempts), imports, sessions, accounts, user; downloaded exports and separate T06 public copy unaffected.
